source_name: ZBS – Združenje bank Slovenije (Bank Association of Slovenia) – members page (Članice)
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the entire Slovenian demand side for banking technology: banks, savings banks (hranilnice) and leasing companies. Logos observed include NLB, Intesa Sanpaolo, OTP, Sparkasse, Addiko, BKS, Gorenjska banka, DBS, Delavska hranilnica, LON, SID, SKB and 10+ leasing firms. This is the master actor list every vendor/partnership finding in workstream A6 must be joined against.

source_name: IKT horizontalna mreža SRIP PMiS (GZS)
why_relevant: The ICT horizontal network of the Smart Cities and Communities SRIP, hosted on a GZS subdomain. Its action plans (PDF) list the partnership composition — 39 micro, 35 small, 13 medium, 14 large enterprises, 5 associations/chambers, universities and institutes — i.e. a named, state-recognised roster of Slovenian ICT solution providers organised by vertical, several of which serve financial services.

source_name: GZS – Zbornica elektronske in elektroindustrije (ZEE)
why_relevant: Adjacent GZS branch chamber covering electronics/electrical industry — the home of hardware manufacturers and device suppliers (terminals, kiosks, self-service, components) that overlap the payments hardware value chain. Board and working-group pages name member firms (e.g. ATECH, DOMEL, ETI, HIDRIA on the RoHS working group).

source_name: GZS — Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT): KATALOGI
why_relevant: The Chamber of Commerce ICT association publishes member catalogues, an ICT reference price list and event programmes. This is the systematic way to enumerate Slovenian IT houses (including those selling into banks) rather than discovering them one brand at a time — the canonical actor-list pointer for this cell.

source_name: GZS ZIT – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije: official member list PDF (Seznam članov)
why_relevant: The single highest-yield artefact for this cell: a maintained, dated (July 2026) roster of Slovenian ICT companies inside the national chamber. It enumerates integrators, software houses and telco/IT suppliers — including small firms invisible to media — that form the candidate pool of banking-sector vendors and Printec competitors/partners.

source_name: GZS – Katalog članov pattern (branch-association member catalogues)
why_relevant: Demonstrates a reusable structural pattern: individual GZS branch associations publish their own 'Katalog podjetij / Katalog članov' pages. Recorded here as a template for systematically enumerating every GZS branch association's member catalogue (including business-services and ICT-adjacent branches) rather than relying on ZIT alone.

source_name: GZS – Podatki o podjetjih in kontaktni naslovi (chamber company-data service)
why_relevant: GZS offers sector-filtered company lists with contact data — the umbrella route to member companies across all its branch associations, not just ZIT. Search result text indicates the detailed contact data is reserved for GZS members, so this is a paywalled/membership-gated pointer to be scoped before relying on it.

source_name: ATVP - Registri (Securities Market Agency register index)
why_relevant: Index of ATVP's statutory registers. ATVP is the second Slovenian supervisor of relevance: it licenses investment firms and, under MiCA, crypto-asset service providers - actors that increasingly overlap with payments.

source_name: ATVP - MiCA / CASP authorisation information and register (crypto-asset service providers in SI)
why_relevant: ATVP is the SI competent authority authorising CASPs under MiCA. The authorised-CASP list is the newest slice of the payments-adjacent competitor universe (stablecoin/e-money overlap, crypto acquiring). ATVP also publishes warnings about unauthorised firms, itself a discovery signal.

source_name: Comtrade programske rešitve / Comtrade SI Sistemske integracije (Slovenia units)
why_relevant: Comtrade's Slovenian legal entities (Letališka cesta 29B, Ljubljana) are a major regional software/system-integration supplier with financial-sector work. The bizi.si company records give the exact entity names, activity codes and banking relationships needed to then query procurement and reference databases correctly — the Slovenian group site itself surfaced poorly in search.

source_name: Agitavit Solutions d.o.o. (Ljubljana) — company record and site
why_relevant: Mid-size Slovenian custom-software house (~97 employees, Letališka cesta 33F) active in finance/insurance business applications. Registry record establishes the entity for procurement and reference tracking; its own site is the follow-on target for banking/insurance case studies. Included as an actor-map entry for the cell.

source_name: COMLAND d.o.o. — company record (razvoj informacijskih rešitev)
why_relevant: Long-established (1991) Slovenian software-development house, ~33 employees, Cesta Ljubljanske brigade 21, Ljubljana. Actor-map entry for the domestic supplier landscape; registry record is the reliable anchor since the vendor site did not surface in search.

source_name: AJPES / company-data aggregators (companywall.si, bizi.si) for Bankart and peers
why_relevant: Company registry mirrors carrying filed financials, ownership, directors and activity codes for Bankart, KDD and related operators — the objective corporate-fact layer beneath self-published marketing, and the way to detect ownership shifts among the five owner banks.

source_name: EBA - Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
why_relevant: Index of all EBA registers (credit institutions, payment/e-money institutions, crowdfunding, credit servicers). Stable entry point for locating the current data-download URLs, which change between releases.

source_name: Slovensko društvo Informatika (SDI) – event organiser page
why_relevant: SDI organises DSI and awards; its events section is the upstream announcement channel for editions, calls for papers, and award ceremonies, useful for discovering new event instances and sub-events (hackathon sponsors, award categories).

source_name: 10times – Slovenia conference directory
why_relevant: Global event aggregator with per-event exhibitor/visitor counts and organiser links; useful as a cross-check and discovery layer for Slovenian and Adriatic banking/payments/IT events not covered by local calendars.

source_name: AHK Slovenija – Slovensko-nemška gospodarska zbornica, member area (Člani / Članstvo)
why_relevant: ~280 member companies forming the largest German–Slovene business network; captures German/Austrian banking-technology and outsourcing suppliers active in Slovenia (a structurally important vendor origin for DACH-owned banks such as Sparkasse, BKS, Addiko, Deželna banka partners).

source_name: AmCham Slovenia – List of Members
why_relevant: 400+ member companies including the Slovenian subsidiaries of US and international technology vendors and the large banks. Cross-sector directory that identifies which multinational payments/IT vendors maintain a Slovenian commercial presence — precisely the competitor set that does not appear in local ICT rosters.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld customer databases (Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, etc.)
why_relevant: Aggregator that enumerates named customers per banking product; useful for rapidly generating a candidate list of which SI/SEE institutions are attributed to which vendor, to be verified against primary vendor pages. Aggregated and partly paywalled, so treat as lead-generation not evidence.

source_name: Blockchain Alliance Europe – Članstvo / Alliance
why_relevant: Slovenia-registered non-profit connecting European companies implementing blockchain/DLT; the closest thing to a Slovenian fintech/crypto industry association with a public membership structure. Members and event pages surface payments-adjacent startups and legal/consulting firms that pitch banks on tokenisation, digital assets and MiCA compliance.

source_name: BSCC – British-Slovenian Chamber of Commerce, Member directory
why_relevant: ~100 members plus published Councils (thematic committees) and Partners pages. Small but high-signal: UK fintech/consulting firms targeting Slovenia, and the council pages expose which banks sit alongside which suppliers.

source_name: Društvo Mali delničarji Slovenije (skupaj.si) – per-bank entity pages
why_relevant: Minority-shareholder association maintains taxonomy pages for essentially every SI bank and savings bank (NLB, Gorenjska, Addiko, SKB, BKS, DBS, Intesa, Delavska hranilnica, Primorska hranilnica, LON, SID, UniCredit), each aggregating contacts and news links. A convenient snowball hub to reach small institutions' own sites.

source_name: Endava digitalne rešitve d.o.o. (Ljubljana) — D&B company profile
why_relevant: Establishes the Slovenian Endava entity (Letališka cesta 29B, Ljubljana; ~231 employees at the location, ~USD 36m reported sales). Endava globally is a banking/payments delivery partner, so its Slovenian delivery centre is a channel through which foreign payments platforms reach the region. The SI unit publishes no client list, so the entity profile plus the global site is the practical tracking route.

source_name: FeaturedCustomers — vendor case-study/reference aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregates vendor-published case studies and references in one place per vendor, which shortens discovery of SI-named references across many banking vendors at once. Content is vendor-supplied marketing, so credibility inherits from the underlying vendor page.

source_name: fintech.svetidej.com – Slovenian fintech services directory
why_relevant: Directory-style catalogue of fintech services available in Slovenia; a cheap enumeration layer for consumer-facing non-bank providers to feed the actor map.

source_name: Mastercard — licensing guide and gateway/partner certification pages
why_relevant: Defines membership/certification categories and lists certified gateway and processing partners; the mechanism by which processor certifications become publicly announceable, and a lookup route from scheme side into national vendor stacks.

source_name: NT konferenca (Brown Bear Team / conference coverage as press proxy)
why_relevant: Slovenia's largest ICT conference (1,400+ participants); sponsor lists, agendas and post-event trade coverage enumerate the active supplier set and who is pitching banking solutions this year - a compact actor map refreshed annually.

source_name: Open Banking Tracker – Slovenia country page
why_relevant: Aggregator listing SI ASPSPs with their developer portals — fastest way to enumerate every Slovenian bank API portal and spot new/changed ones; third-party curation so treat as lead list, not truth.

entity_name: PayTech.Events / European Digital Finance Association event listings
source_name: PayTech.Events / European Digital Finance Association event listings
why_relevant: Third-party aggregators of payments-industry events with dates, agendas and links; useful for discovering regional payments events (beyond Money Motion) that Slovenian vendors and banks attend, and for backfilling past editions.

source_name: SBC – Klub slovenskih podjetnikov (Slovenian Business Club)
why_relevant: 450-member entrepreneurs' club running conferences, press conferences and webinars; its member directory and event partners identify Slovenian companies (incl. IT/fintech suppliers) and the banks that sponsor business-community events. Weaker signal than dedicated banking events but useful for partnership mapping.

source_name: SloExport — Slovenian exporters directory (company cards)
why_relevant: Official-adjacent directory of Slovenian exporting companies with structured company cards (activity, products, markets). Useful for identifying which domestic IT houses actually export banking software beyond SI — i.e. which ones are genuine regional competitors rather than local-only integrators.

source_name: Slovenian academic repositories (RUL / ReVIS / CEK-EF UL theses on bank IT renewal)
why_relevant: Slovene master's/diploma theses on bank information-system renewal and payment innovation frequently name the institution, the supplier and the project timeline in detail no press release provides. Slow-moving but unusually specific, and open access.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija – digitalna.si
why_relevant: National multi-stakeholder digital coalition whose signatories include GZS (on behalf of the Digital Partnership of the Economy), government, rectors' conference, research institutes, municipalities and NGO networks. Its open forums assemble vendors and public-sector buyers; the signatory/partner list is a map of who is institutionally licensed to shape Slovenian digitalisation policy.

source_name: Telex.si - media aggregator view of Necenzurirano and other outlets
why_relevant: Slovenian news aggregator that indexes per-outlet feeds (confirmed page listing Necenzurirano items). Cheap way to discover which outlets are running a given bank/vendor story without subscribing to each.

source_name: The Recursive — CEE/SEE startup and fintech mapping
why_relevant: Runs mapping articles listing 60+ CEE fintech companies by country — a pointer source that yields new actor names and their websites for the Slovenian/Adriatic vendor map.

source_name: thebanks.eu – EMI list for Slovenia
why_relevant: English-language aggregator that enumerates Slovenian EMIs with profile pages; useful cross-check and entity-discovery shortcut against the BSI registers, but secondary — always confirm against BSI.

source_name: Tracxn — Slovenia fintech company/deal database
why_relevant: Deal-aggregator listing ~136 Slovenian fintech entities with funding status; fastest way to enumerate candidate vendors/competitors and their URLs for downstream monitoring. Directory, not evidence.

source_name: Visa Partner Directory (Visa Ready certified issuer processors)
why_relevant: Scheme-maintained directory of certified issuer processors and technology partners; filtering by geography surfaces which processors are scheme-certified to serve SI issuers — a structured alternative to scattered press releases.

source_name: Wikipedija – Seznam bank v Sloveniji
why_relevant: Fast, free crosswalk of bank names, historical names and mergers (Abanka, Sberbank/N Banka, Nova KBM, SKB) — useful for building the alias table needed to search Slovenian newsrooms and to find archived pre-merger announcements.
